description: The chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model for two fine-tuned models, NESAC and SESHA, across various optimizations. The vertical axis lists the categories of optimizations applied, namely Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates, while the horizontal axis represents the difference in average WER, ranging from 0.000 to 0.003 in increments of 0.001. The chart features grouped bars, with orange representing the NESAC fine-tuned model and green representing the SESHA fine-tuned model. For each optimization, the NESAC model has values of 0.00334 for Normalised, 0.00319 for Add Spacing, 0.00311 for Remove Spacing, 0.00299 for Americanisms, and 0.00257 for Dates, while the SESHA model has corresponding values of 0.00323, 0.00344, 0.00306, 0.00302, and 0.00228. The bars are sorted in descending order based on the SESHA model's values, and no bars are visually emphasized.
